properties.description: RAW ADHOC 마스터. Ins_master_run(스크립트) -> run_check -> 수집 이력 생성 -> dispatcher -> Master 종료. 소스 DB명 / 추출쿼리 / landing_path / file_name 을 파라미터로 받아 GEN2 에 수집 (TABLE sink 없음)

activities.name: Ins_master_run
activities.description: Master PENDING 등록 + 검증 (그룹 / 필수 파라미터 / ADHOC 대상 1건). 실패하면 마스터도 실패 (Master 행 없음)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_adhoc > Script "Ins_master_run" (pl_raw_orch_full 기반, ADHOC 단순화)
   마스터 첫 활동. ctl_master_pipeline_run 에 이번 실행을 PENDING 으로 등록 + 시작 조건 검증

   실행 조합 : run_group_id 지정 / init_load_group NULL / override NULL
               (ck_master_entry 의 '그룹 실행' 조합)

   검증 실패 : 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (문장 전체 취소, Master 행 생성 안 됨)
     MASTER_PARAM_MISSING:RunId/파이프라인명
     RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_JOB_TYPE:그룹명
       그룹 없음 / 비활성 / job_type_cd 가 ADHOC 아님
     ADHOC_PARAM_MISSING:p_src_db_nm,...
       필수 파라미터 누락 (소스 DB명, 추출쿼리, landing_path, file_name)
     ADHOC_TARGET_NOT_FOUND_OR_DUP:DB명 cnt=N
       이 그룹에서 소스 DB명에 해당하는 GEN2 대상이 정확히 1건이 아님

   사용자 입력 문자열은 작은따옴표를 이중화(replace)하여 SQL 리터럴로 전달.
   같은 master_run_id 재호출 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용
*/
WITH p AS (
    SELECT
           NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().RunId}'), '')::text
               AS master_run_id,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().Pipeline}'), '')::text
               AS pipeline_nm,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS run_group_nm,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_src_db_nm, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS src_db_nm,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_extract_query, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS extract_query,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_landing_path, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS landing_path,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_file_name, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS file_name,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_requester, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
               AS requester,

           COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().TriggerType}'), ''), 'Manual')::text
               AS trigger_type,

           COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().TriggerName}'), ''), 'Manual')::text
               AS trigger_nm,

           NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().DataFactory}'), '')::text
               AS created_by
),

/* 필수 파라미터 누락 목록 (없으면 빈 문자열) */
pm AS (
    SELECT concat_ws(',',
               CASE WHEN src_db_nm    IS NULL THEN 'p_src_db_nm'    END,
               CASE WHEN extract_query IS NULL THEN 'p_extract_query' END,
               CASE WHEN landing_path IS NULL THEN 'p_landing_path' END,
               CASE WHEN file_name    IS NULL THEN 'p_file_name'    END
           ) AS missing
      FROM p
),

/* 그룹 : 활성 + ADHOC */
g AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           g.run_group_id
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd = 'ADHOC'
),

/* 이번 실행 대상 건수 (검증용, Start_ingest_pipeline Script 와 같은 조건) */
tgt AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS cnt
      FROM g
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_run_rule r
        ON r.run_group_id = g.run_group_id
       AND r.enabled_yn = 'Y'
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
        ON m.target_id = r.target_id
       AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
       AND m.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
       AND upper(m.src_db_nm) = upper(g.src_db_nm)
),

ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (
           master_run_id,
           master_pipeline_nm,
           trigger_type_cd,
           adf_trigger_nm,
           run_group_id,
           run_param,
           child_total_cnt,
           status,
           created_by
          )
    SELECT g.master_run_id,
           g.pipeline_nm,

           CASE
               WHEN upper(g.trigger_type) = 'MANUAL'
               THEN 'MANUAL'
               ELSE 'SCHEDULE'
           END,

           g.trigger_nm,
           g.run_group_id,

           jsonb_strip_nulls(
               jsonb_build_object(
                   'src_db_nm',    g.src_db_nm,
                   'landing_path', g.landing_path,
                   'file_name',    g.file_name,
                   'requester',    g.requester
               )
           ),

           0,
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by

      FROM g
     WHERE g.master_run_id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.pipeline_nm IS NOT NULL

    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
           master_run_id,
           trigger_type_cd,
           adf_trigger_nm,
           run_group_id,
           run_param,
           child_total_cnt,
           status
)

SELECT i.master_run_id,
       i.trigger_type_cd,
       i.adf_trigger_nm,
       i.run_group_id,
       i.run_param::text AS run_param,
       i.child_total_cnt,
       i.status,

       CASE
           WHEN (
               SELECT master_run_id IS NULL
                   OR pipeline_nm IS NULL
                 FROM p
           )
           THEN (
               'MASTER_PARAM_MISSING:'
               ||
               (
                   SELECT COALESCE(master_run_id, '')
                          || '/'
                          || COALESCE(pipeline_nm, '')
                     FROM p
               )
           )::int

           WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g) = 0
           THEN (
               'RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_JOB_TYPE:'
               ||
               COALESCE(
                   (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p),
                   ''
               )
           )::int

           WHEN (SELECT missing FROM pm) <> ''
           THEN (
               'ADHOC_PARAM_MISSING:'
               ||
               (SELECT missing FROM pm)
           )::int

           WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM tgt) <> 1
           THEN (
               'ADHOC_TARGET_NOT_FOUND_OR_DUP:'
               ||
               (SELECT src_db_nm FROM p)
               ||
               ' cnt='
               ||
               (SELECT cnt FROM tgt)::text
           )::int

           ELSE 1
       END AS chk

  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i
    ON TRUE;

activities.name: Exec_run_check
activities.description: 전역 skip / Trigger 이력. SKIP 이면 Master = SKIPPED (BIZDAY 판정은 사용 안 함)

text.value:
/* Fail_master_run_check : Exec_run_check 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Exec_run_check] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Exec_run_check').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

activities.name: Start_ingest_pipeline Script
activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 1건 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_adhoc > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
   (pl_raw_orch_full 기반, ADHOC 단순화)

   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환
   + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 1건 생성.
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (예: SKIPPED) 0건 반환

   대상 :
     ADHOC 그룹(p_run_group_nm)에 등록된 GEN2 대상 중
     소스 DB명(p_src_db_nm)과 같은 대상 1건
     (ctl_ingest_run_group / target_run_rule / target_master 직접 조인)

   추출 위치 :
     COALESCE(NULLIF(cdc_tgt_db_nm, ''), src_db_nm)
     -> 자식 수집 파이프라인명 결정 (pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB})

   추출쿼리 / landing_path / file_name :
     파라미터 값을 그대로 사용 (토큰 치환 없음)

   적재방식(load_method_cd) : NULL
     (ck_ingest_type_method / ck_ingest_sink_gen2 에서 ADHOC 허용)
   범위 컬럼 : 모두 NULL (ck_ingest_range)

   Script 재시도 = 0 (재시도 시 수집 이력 중복 생성).
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
*/
WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().RunId}'), '')::text
            AS master_run_id,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
            AS run_group_nm,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_src_db_nm, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
            AS src_db_nm,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_extract_query, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
            AS extract_query,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_landing_path, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
            AS landing_path,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{replace(pipeline().parameters.p_file_name, '''', '''''')}'), '')::text
            AS file_name,

        NULLIF(btrim('@{pipeline().DataFactory}'), '')::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 + 자식 파이프라인명 */
t AS (
    SELECT
        g.run_group_id,
        r.run_rule_id,
        m.target_id,
        m.data_class,
        m.src_type,
        m.src_db_nm,
        m.src_schema_nm,
        m.src_table_nm,
        m.cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        m.sink_type_cd,

        'pl_'
        || lower(m.data_class)
        || '_ingest_'
        || lower(m.src_type)
        || '_'
        || upper(
               COALESCE(
                   NULLIF(btrim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),
                   m.src_db_nm
               )
           )
            AS pl_nm

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
      ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
     AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
     AND g.job_type_cd = 'ADHOC'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_run_rule r
      ON r.run_group_id = g.run_group_id
     AND r.enabled_yn = 'Y'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = r.target_id
     AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     AND m.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
     AND upper(m.src_db_nm) = upper(p.src_db_nm)
),

/* 2. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (+ 대상 건수)
      SKIPPED 등 다른 상태면 0건 -> 수집 이력 생성 안 함 */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status          = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt        = now(),
           updated_by      = p.created_by,
           updated_dt      = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
                 FROM t
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 3. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (Master 가 RUNNING 으로 전환된 경우만) */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'ADHOC',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(btrim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),
        NULLIF(btrim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''),

        t.data_class,

        p.extract_query,
        p.landing_path,
        p.file_name,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t
    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,
        target_id,
        status
)

/* 4. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,
    landing_path,
    file_name,
    target_id,
    status

FROM ins;

activities.name: ForEach_child_ingest
activities.description: ADHOC 수집 대상 1건 자식 수집 파이프라인 호출 (SKIPPED 등으로 0건이면 건너뜀)

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Start_ingest_pipeline Script').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

message.value: @{pipeline().Pipeline} 파이프라인 수행 중 Child Ingest Pipeline 수행 장애발생
